properties.title: NRC Report: Hydraulic Oil near Denton, NC
properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 1028157 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: CCC GROUP
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1028157
Incident Time: 2012-10-23 09:15:00
Nearest City: Denton, NC
Location: JLG HYDRAULIC HOSE RUPTURE AT BOAT RAMP NEAR HIGH ROCK POWERHOUSE 3344 BRINGLE FERRY ROAD
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: HYDRAULIC OIL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: CCC GROUP
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.633748, -80.118930 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 0.5 gallons
Report Description
AT APPROXIMATELY 9:15 AM CCC GROUP WAS MOVING MATERIAL WITH A JLG ALL-TERRAIN FORKLIFT IN THE AREA OF THE BOAT RAMP AT THE CAISSON LAUNCH AREA WHEN A HYDRAULIC HOSE RUPTURED IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT. THE ENGINE PLACEMENT IS BEHIND THE OPERATOR AND THE LEAK WAS NOTICED BY ANOTHER CREW MEMBER AS THE OPERATOR MOVED ONTO THE CONCRETE RAMP AREA AS THE LIFT MOVED UP THE HILL AWAY FROM THE WATER. APPROXIMATELY .5 GALLON OF HYDRAULIC OIL WAS LEAKED ONTO THE CONCRETE APPROXIMATELY 30’ FROM THE WATER, NO OIL CONTACTED THE WATER AND NO OIL SHEEN WAS OBSERVED IN THE LAKE. AN OIL BOOM WAS IN THE WATER AROUND THE AREA WHERE THE LIFT WOULD ACCESS THE BARGE; THIS WAS PUT IN PLACE PRIOR TO WORKING ON THE RAMP AREA AS A PRECAUTION TO CONTAIN ANY POTENTIAL SPILL. THE OPERATOR STOPPED THE LIFT ON THE GRAVEL AREA AWAY FROM THE RAMP WHERE PLASTIC AND OIL ABSORBENT PADS WERE PLACED UNDER THE PIECE OF EQUIPMENT TO CONSTRUCT A SECONDARY CONTAINMENT TO CATCH ANY ADDITIONAL OIL LEAKS. OIL ABSORBENT WAS PLACED ON ANY OIL LOCATED ON THE CONCRETE AND ALSO IN THE GRAVEL PARKING AREA THEN CLEANED UP AND PLACED IN OPEN TOP DRUMS FOR DISPOSAL BY APGI. THE RENTAL COMPANY SENT A CREW TO MAKE THE REQUIRED REPAIRS PRIOR TO MOVING THE LIFT TO PREVENT ANY FURTHER LEAKS; THE PIECE OF EQUIPMENT WILL BE REMOVED FROM THE JOB SITE BY THE RENTAL COMPANY AND A REPLACEMENT WILL BE DELIVERED.

Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 2 feet by 15 feet (area 30 sq. ft.)
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
ON 4/15/2011 @ 10:00 AM WHILE FISHING THE CHARLES RIVER AT # 135 ELM STREET IN WALTHAM MASS I NOTICED A DEEP BLUE SHEEN OF OIL FLOWING INTO THE RIVER. I FOLLOWED THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN AND SAW THAT IT WAS COMING FROM THE YARD OF BOSTON BARK CORP AND THEY WERE PRESSURE WASHING TRUCKS & HEAVY EQUIPMENT AT THAT TIME. THEIR YARD BORDERS THE RIVER AND THERE ARE NO DRAINS ON THIER PROPERTY AND ALL OF THE BACK WASH FLOWS RIGHT INTO THE RIVER. IT SEEMS AS THIS HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR A WHILE AS THE GROUND IS VERY DIRTY & OILY SMELLING WHERE IT FLOWS INTO THE RIVER. I WOULD HAVE TO SAY THAT THIS HAS A BIG IMPACT ON THE FISH & WILD LIFE THERE ON THE CHARLES RIVER.
